summary: Tested the 3-tier coaching memberships end to end, backend and frontend. Backend: 18/18 new pytest cases pass, covering plans, admin save validation, the full gold E2E flow (request→accept→paylink→402→mark paid→active→check-in→weigh-in→coach reply→pending list→resources), add_days, paylink replacement, silver/bronze module gating (403) and the cron (401, queued, duplicate, renewal created). The existing coaching regression suites also pass (26 passed, 1 skipped). Frontend: /coaching tier selection, general query, submit; /account MembershipCard none/active/pending; /portal for gold (all sections, check-in submit, progress, messages, resources), silver (locked resources), mobile nav; locked states and the unauthenticated redirect; coach membership panel, check-in reply and protocol supplements; admin plan editor, resources and requests tier column. Found and fixed 2 frontend bugs: a JSX conditional on /coaching was missing, and the weekly-ratings bars did not grow with the rating.

minor.issue: Uses order.paid_at as a datetime, but routes/square_routes.py (lines ~270, 343, 441) stores paid_at as an ISO STRING. A membership order paid via the Square webhook/sync/poll would raise TypeError (str vs datetime compare / str + timedelta), causing a 500 on /my/membership and in the cron. Wallid, manual and PayPal store datetime, so it works today on those routes. Fix: parse it when it is a str, or normalise Square to a datetime.
Uses (paid_until-now).days, which rounds down: a fresh 30-day payment shows '29 days left' and +7 comp shows '6 days left'. Consider math.ceil.
The resource min_tier field is stored but never enforced or filtered; only the module gate applies.
Guarded by require_coach rather than admin despite the /admin path, so any coach can add or delete global resources. Confirm this is intended.
mark_order_paid sends the generic order-confirmation email and admin notify for membership orders (address1 'Coaching membership'). Check that the wording suits a membership.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: `{submitted ? (` was missing before the success <section>. The success card and form were always rendered together, and stray ') : (' / ')}' text showed on the page.
FIXED: the bar wrapper had no height, so the percentage height collapsed to 4px. Added h-full justify-end; the energy-7 bar is now 67px.

issues: The saved supplement_plan is only visible inside the protocol edit form; read mode does not show it.
Gold shows the same 4 tiles as Silver; there is no tile or entry point for the Resources library or the 1-to-1 video call.
Uses the browser's native <input type=date> and <select> instead of shadcn Calendar/Select (inconsistent with the rest of the app).
After creating a silver link for a gold-requested client, the badge still shows GOLD until payment. This may confuse coaches; consider showing the 'requested: silver' tier.

action_items: Make _apply_membership_payments tolerate string paid_at (Square routes store isoformat strings), or store a datetime in square_routes
Enforce or remove resource min_tier; decide whether coaches or only admins manage resources
Show supplement_plan in coach read mode; add Resources/Video-call tiles for Gold on the dashboard
critical_code_review_comments: Square paid_at stored as a string breaks the membership date maths (latent 500)
Coaching.jsx conditional-rendering bug (fixed); please check the file renders correctly after your next edits
Coach PATCH membership lets a coach set tier/paid_until freely (comp access). Fine if intended, but not audited/logged

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (2 bugs found and fixed; minor UX notes)

seed_data_creation: TEST_ users test_tier_*, test_ui_gold_*, test_ui_pending_*, test_ui_plain_* @example.com (password Test1234!), plus their coaching requests. Their clients were deactivated, membership orders deleted and resources deleted. Check-ins, weigh-ins, messages and the TEST_ui protocol remain attached to the deactivated clients. Bronze price was changed to 55 and restored to 49.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest tests/test_coaching_tiers_membership.py -p no:randomly (the tests are ordered and use shared state). setup_portal_members.py creates gold/pending/plain UI users and writes their tokens to /tmp/ui_members.json. For UI, set localStorage ghp_token and sessionStorage ghp_age_verified='true' to skip the age gate. Cron runs process ALL active clients in the DB (renewal emails to real clients are possible). Checkout UI was not re-tested in the browser, only via the regression pytest suites.
